model.headline: What is Arena Property?
model.title: The smart way to own the Caribbean
model.description: You buy 1/8 of a premium vacation property, registered in your name through a trust, and a single operator takes care of everything else.

owner.title: You are a real owner
owner.description: Your 1/8 is registered in the project's trust. Real ownership of a beachfront asset.

price.title: From COP $173M
price.description: In installments and with no additional mortgage. Access the most premium asset in Bocagrande with a fraction of the total capital.

carefree.title: Worry-free
carefree.description: A single tourism operator manages rentals, guests and monthly reporting. Distributions proportional to your 1/8.

benefits.headline: Benefits
benefits.title: Eight owners, zero worries
benefits.description: Compared with buying a whole property, a fraction gives you the best of the Caribbean for part of the cost and none of the operational burden.

capital.title: A fraction of the capital
capital.description: From COP $173M in 30 installments, instead of more than COP $1,384M for the whole apartment.

weeks.title: 42 nights a year
weeks.description: Weeks spread across the four seasons, with fair rotation among the eight co-owners.

income.title: Income when you're not there
income.description: Free nights are rented to third parties and the income is shared with your fraction.

management.title: Centralized operation
management.description: Scheduling, common expenses, maintenance and communication all live on the platform.

ownership.title: Your fraction is yours
ownership.description: Registered in a trust and traceable; transfer it whenever you decide.

transparency.title: Clear accounts
transparency.description: Monthly reports and every peso on record. Nothing estimated is shown as confirmed.

cta.title: Reserve your spot in Invictvs
cta.description: Bocagrande beachfront, 53 floors and estimated delivery in 2029. Create your account and we'll walk with you from the first call to your registered fraction.
